items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Joe Moraz has him. [INTERVIEWEE] He has the records.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's right. They put them on there. But this guy named that, it is Allen or Allen, Allen, and that's his name?
He has the records. Yeah. But I mean the guy that we did the record for, you remember his name? Oh, Al VanCote.
